summary: Vice President JD Vance made headlines this week by revealing he's "obsessed" with accessing UFO files, though his stated reasoning – that extraterrestrials are "demons" – drew swift pushback from Harvard astrophysicist Avi Loeb and others in the research community. Meanwhile, the 3I/ATLAS mystery deepened with reports of nuclear fuel signatures detected in connection with the object, and investigative journalist Ross Coulthart raised fresh concerns about the ongoing disappearance of General Gregory McCasland, suggesting possible foul play. On the document front, AARO released its 2025 trifold summary, and archival records from mid-2024 through late 2024 continue to be added to the public record. With the FY2026 NDAA UAP briefing deadline set for June 30 and Contact in the Desert scheduled for May 28, disclosure momentum appears to be building even as some key figures and cases remain unresolved.
